scenario.title: Separate studio sales from material costs
scenario.goal: Use a jewelry-studio bookkeeping example to distinguish finished-goods sales, material purchases, customer deposits and workshop costs.
steps: Review the sample material and finished-piece accounts used by the example.
Trace a purchase and sale through the inventory, revenue and cost accounts.
Review a customer return or correction and its source link.
Compare the month-end result with the remaining material value.
checks: Metal, gemstone and finished-piece amounts are illustrative and do not claim commodity or fair-value accounting.
Customer deposits, hallmarking, consignment, appraisal and workshop job costing are not implemented.
The pack is a bookkeeping preview; specialist treatment and runtime replay are outside this candidate contract.
